devdoc.details: A simplified escrow contract for managing freelance talents.

acceptHiredTalent(uint256,uint256).details: Accept an available hiredTalent and set deadline (Freelancer accepts hiredTalent offered by client)

params._talentId: The ID of the talent this hiredTalent belongs to
The ID of the talent this hiredTalent belongs to

confirmClientCompletion(uint256,uint256,.details: Confirm client hiredTalent completion (both parties must confirm in order to complete the hiredTalent) This function allows either the client or freelancer to confirm that the hiredTalent has been completed. If both parties confirm, the hiredTalent is marked as finished and payment is released.

params._hiredTalentId: The hiredTalent ID to confirm completion
params._talentId: The ID of the talent this hiredTalent belongs to

confirmFreelancerCompletion(uint256,uint.details: Confirm client hiredTalent completion (both parties must confirm in order to complete the hiredTalent) This function allows either the client or freelancer to confirm that the hiredTalent has been completed. If both parties confirm, the hiredTalent is marked as finished and payment is released.

params._hiredTalentId: The hiredTalent ID to confirm completion
params._talentId: The ID of the talent this hiredTalent belongs to

params._arbitrator: Address of the arbitrator for dispute resolution

createHiredTalent(uint256,(string,string.details: Create a new hiredTalent under an existing talent (Client creates hiredTalent)

params._talentId: The ID of the talent to create a hiredTalent under

createTalent((string,string,string,strin.details: Create a new talent (Freelancer creates hiredTalent offer)

params._hiredTalentId: The hiredTalent ID to emergency cancel

getHiredTalentCount(uint256).details: Get the number of hiredTalents in a talent

returns._0: Number of hiredTalents in the talent

rateHiredTalent(uint256,uint256,uint8).details: Internal function to rate a hiredTalent

params._rating: The rating given by the client (1-5)
params._talentId: The ID of the talent this hiredTalent belongs to

startDispute(uint256,uint256,string,uint.details: Start a dispute for a hiredTalent (either party can start a dispute)

params._bondAmount: Amount to be used as bond for the first answer
params._bountyAmount: Amount to be used as bounty for the dispute
params._comment: Comment explaining the reason for the dispute
params._escalateToArbitrator: Whether to escalate the dispute to an arbitrator immediately
params._talentId: The ID of the talent posting this hiredTalent belongs to

uploadDeliverable(uint256,uint256,(strin.details: Allows the freelancer to upload a deliverable.

params._deliverableParams: The content of the deliverable (IPFS hash and comment).
